paragrafo1: Nice to meet you—I’m Gerê! I’m the kind of friend everyone wants to have around. You’ll find me at after-work happy hours, birthday parties, and those long, never-ending conversations. Geremia was born from me, and above all else, I embody friendship. Since 2015, I’ve been welcoming Uberaba with open arms, blending the spirit of traditional big-city bars with that signature, warm hospitality typical of Minas Gerais.
paragrafo2: I take my draft beer seriously here! My Antarctica is served in the house’s own crystal tulip glass, which makes the beer light and creamy—just the way it should be. There’s also Brahma Black, Heineken, and Amstel—all perfectly poured and ice-cold. You can count on it!
paragrafo3: My kitchen is inspired by the flavors of Minas Gerais, and everything is prepared right here on-site. From the sauce for our parmegiana to our famous coxinha (chicken croquette) made without any dough, everything comes straight from our kitchen. Our torresminho (crispy pork belly bits) are perfectly crunchy! And to round off your meal in style, be sure to order the *fraldinha* (flank steak), the parmegiana, and the pudim (flan). It’s food with the authentic taste of Minas, prepared with the same care as if it were being cooked for one’s own family.
paragrafo4: Take a seat and forget about the clock. I’ve prepared everything so you can relax; the atmosphere is comfortable and welcoming. But my greatest asset is my team. From the server to the chef, everyone looks after your table with care and attention they’re all part of my story! Here, we’re a family, and you’re always welcome.
paragrafo5: Find me here. I’m on one of the most beautiful streets in Uberaba, lined with trees and easy to reach, right across from the SESI Theater and next to the Hotel Tamareiras. It’s the perfect spot for a draft beer before or after the show.
paragrafo6: Traditional cuisine from Minas Gerais, appetizers, and super creamy draft beer served in the perfect glass.
